pages.text: Ember Grove, Sulfur Springs, Ember Meadow, Wartvine Tangle, Hellwood Jungle, Molten Glass Lake and vanilla biomes. At its heart, the $(l)Infernal Warlock$(): walls of fire advance across the arena, find the gap. Kill his Stalkers first, they shield him.

A stepped temple ringed by a lava moat. Beneath it, $(l)walkways over a lake of lava$(): find the gap in the walls of fire, leave the meteor circles, and do not fall. The chest on the threshold holds $(l)fire resistance$(). The temple can be climbed.
